analysis.answer: Under current law, possessing any amount of cannabis is a misdemeanor carrying up to 90 days in jail. The measure changes this by allowing adults 21 and older to possess up to one ounce without it being an offense.

Police and prosecutors will likely redirect resources previously used to enforce cannabis possession laws. Individuals 21 and older may consume cannabis more openly or frequently without fear of arrest.
The measure addresses the criminalization of low-level cannabis possession by removing legal penalties for adults holding up to one ounce.
